_comment: Era I look per region (world area, Act II: Corvane gets its own world). palette = the 4 inks of the screen filter, darkest to lightest; each must stay in its luminance band (<0.25, <0.5, <0.75, >=0.75) so EraManager's filter maps every sprite the same way. The region's tiles are art/era1/tiles/overworld_<region>.png (TilesetFactory.atlas_path; Corvane's from tools/art/gen_tiles_corvane.py, which reads this palette). biome = the look's name, props = what its atlas draws. Regions not listed use the base Ink palette. Post-game era regions set "era" (Quillmarch: 3): their palette is the atlas palette of that era (up to 16 colours, Era III has no screen filter), drawn by tools/art/gen_tiles_<region>.py into art/era<N>/tiles/overworld_<region>.png; EraManager.inks_for() only takes a four-ink palette.

corvane.arrive: The ink turns blue here. Corvane dyes everything, even the truth.

ashmere.arrive: The ink goes grey here. Ashmere burned once and still smells like it owes you money.

quillmarch.arrive: The lines grow sharp here. Quillmarch engraves everything, especially what you owe.
